scope: Fourth post-recovery mechanics frontier reconciliation for existing canonical skill identities; evidence-only promotion of the next unaudited cohort from the repository's research layer.

records.name: Energy Release
records.mechanics_boundary: Towa-exclusive stationary Ki-charge stance. Current Xenoverse 2 evidence describes it as slower than Energy Charge; Towa is the documented user and the skill is not separately obtainable by CaCs. Exact charge rate, frame timing, and total refill timing remain unresolved.

records.name: Super Destructo-Disc
records.mechanics_boundary: Chargeable large Destructo-Disc that tracks and is unblockable; current evidence distinguishes it from the normal Destructo-Disc by faster travel, no restand, and combo potential after sufficiently long knockback. Tracking can be engaged after firing while unlocked and then locking on.

records.name: Android Rush
records.mechanics_boundary: Four-hit rush: three kicks followed by a final backhand/punch/kick that launches the opponent. Directional input changes the final knockback route: neutral forward, up downward, down upward. Current evidence reports about 10% total damage.

records.name: Burning Attack
records.mechanics_boundary: Long hand-seal startup followed by a large projectile that explodes on impact, launches the opponent upward, and can briefly stun/trip them. Current skill-specific evidence reports about 15% damage.

records.name: Chaos Shot
records.mechanics_boundary: Uncharged version fires Ki Blasts in multiple directions for two hits; holding the input concentrates the attack forward for nine hits. Current source-reported damage is about 10% uncharged and 15% charged; the move is associated with Frost.

records.name: Surging Spirit
records.mechanics_boundary: Built-in Ultra Instinct Ki-charge action rather than a separately acquired equipable skill. Goku (Ultra Instinct) and Goku (Ultra Instinct -Sign-) use it; CaCs can access it while Ultra Instinct is active through the dedicated guard+heavy input. Current evidence describes roughly five seconds to refill Ki and identifies it as slightly faster than Maximum Charge.

records.name: Reverse Shot
records.mechanics_boundary: Four Ki bullets fire initially; if a blast has not hit after roughly one second it reverses and tracks from behind. At red health the move instead fires eight blasts. Current references report about 5% total damage normally and 15% at red health.

records.name: Grand Smasher
records.mechanics_boundary: Large Ki ball Ultimate; current evidence reports 21 hits and about 35% damage. While the projectile is touching the opponent, an additional input spends 100 more Ki and detonates it for five extra unblockable hits, establishing a documented 300–400 Ki resource range.

evidence_policy: Canonical skills.json remains authoritative; this artifact is evidence-only.
Source-reported costs, hit counts, damage, durations, and timing are bounded by their cited evidence and are not treated as patch-independent constants.
Do not infer unsupported frames, hidden gates, probabilities, or scaling.
Keep built-in Surging Spirit distinct from separately acquired equipable charge skills.
Do not create PQ reward relationships from acquisition endpoints without explicit reward evidence.

validation.identity_scope: All eight identities already exist; no canonical duplicate identities or unsupported relationships were created.
